growth_paths.what: turns rows incl. one per failed resend
turn_events: every streamed delta persisted, never trimmed post-completion
notebook/assessment/reading-quiz rows; regenerate mints new turn_id UNIQUE slots

risks.risk: failed-resend loop adds one turn + its events per retry; superseded failed turns never deleted
risks.trigger: N retries of a failing submission (provider-outage loop)

risks.risk: regenerate deletes only the assistant message; superseded turn row + events retained with dangling assistant_message_id (no FK)
bare delete_message leaves dangling parent_message_id; get_message_path silently truncates LLM context at the hole (measured 4->2 rows)
risks.trigger: regenerate replace path or channel deletion of a row with children

risks.risk: paired branch delete resolves exactly one turn; regenerated sibling turns survive (measured 3->2)
risks.trigger: deleting the user message of a regenerated exchange

risks.risk: turn_submissions has no created_at; rows live until session hard delete; NULL-turn rows after turn deletion are dead weight
notebook/assessment rows survive hard delete (SET NULL) with turn_id strings referencing deleted turns (no FK)
risks.trigger: hard delete of a session that saved notebook/assessment rows

risks.risk: placeholder sessions list as regular conversations; no cleanup path
recycle-bin retention forever; no TTL sweep; hard delete only via explicit API
risks.trigger: users delete conversations without emptying the bin

risks.risk: auto_vacuum=0, no scheduled VACUUM; file never shrinks after mass delete (measured page_count 109->109, freelist 0->58)
WAL bounded by short-lived connections + default autocheckpoint; long-lived external read would stall checkpointing
answer text stored twice (messages.content + turn_events deltas); read caps do not bound storage (measured 102,800 payload bytes per 200-delta turn)
crash-reaped turns become failed rows and join the R1 debris pool
risks.trigger: worker crash mid-turn then recovery pass

recommendations: recycle-bin TTL sweep reusing hard_delete cascade (R8)
delete superseded failed turns on successful resend, or startup sweep for old failed turns without assistant rows (R1/R12)
give delete_message the #912 parent splice and null dangling turns.assistant_message_id (R2/R3)
resolve all sibling turns when deleting a user message pair (R4)
add created_at to turn_submissions and expire stale/NULL-turn rows inside the #1793 reservation window (R5)
stop persisting pure CONTENT deltas or trim turn_events to the trace-preview cap post-completion, keeping result/done/usage events (R11)
enable auto_vacuum=INCREMENTAL + periodic incremental_vacuum, or offline VACUUM in the migration-window precedent (R9)
optional backfill of dead notebook turn_id refs (R6)
